fn='''def transform(grid):
    # Separator color forms full rows/columns; each bounded panel is a cell.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    sep = max((v for v in counts), key=lambda v: sum(1 for row in grid if all(x == v for x in row)) + sum(1 for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(grid[r][c] == v for r in range(len(grid)))))
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == sep for v in row)]
    cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(grid[i][j] == sep for i in range(len(grid)))]
    rb = [-1] + rows + [len(grid)]
    cb = [-1] + cols + [len(grid[0])]
    interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if r not in rows and c not in cols]
    freq = Counter(interior)
    background = max(freq, key=freq.get)
    marker_candidates = [v for v in freq if v != background]
    marker = max(marker_candidates, key=lambda v: freq[v]) if marker_candidates else None
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            n = sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(rb[ri]+1, rb[ri+1]) for c in range(cb[ci]+1, cb[ci+1]))
            row.append(1 if n == 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
